last_error_summary:
❌ YT_REFRESH_TOKEN is invalid or expired.
   Common cause: OAuth consent screen is in 'Testing' mode (tokens expire after 7 days).

   FIX:
   1. Go to https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials/consent
      → click PUBLISH APP (ignore the 'Needs verification' warning).
   2. Regenerate lo
